W.note: Three working loops with per-card pause, a live progress readout, measured overshoot and rest-by values, copyable CSS, and a Play-once reduced-motion path, though punch-and-stick and sticky-settle are close in shape while the 5% kick is clearly different.

X.note: The page throws a ReferenceError (blurbs is read inside a forEach before its const declaration), so no cards or loops render at all in the screenshots or frames, even though the harness sheet shows the curves are distinct.

Y.note: The strongest presentation, with peak and rest-by readouts, Play-once per card, clean mobile layout and reduced-motion handling, but two of its three curves are the same as W's and the third is nearly identical, so the set does not read as three distinct curves.

Z.note: The wind-up-pop curve gives a genuinely distinct, punchy anticipation and pop, but the sticky-punch overshoot reads as bouncy rather than sticky, the mini plots crowd their labels, there are no overshoot or rest values, and there is no reduced-motion handling.
